title: Can We Trust This Evaluation? Instance-Level Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge
abstract: arXiv:2610.14029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation commonly aggregates multiple judges' decisions into a majority vote, yet this panel decision process does not guarantee that the evaluation of an individual item is reliable. We propose Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk (SCUR), a label-free approach for estimating instance-level evaluation reliability based on the judge panel's behavior. A latent measurement model serves as the backbone for measurement system analysis, from which SCUR derives three complementary signals capturing panel uncertainty, measurement cross-entropy, and perturbation sensitivity. These three sources of evidence are combined into a risk score. We evaluate the SCUR approach on five real-world benchmarks using majority-vote error ranking, selective trust, and risk stratification. translated_title: 我们能信任这个评估吗？LLM-as-a-Judge（大语言模型作为评判者）的实例级可靠性
translated_abstract: LLM-as-a-judge（大语言模型作为评判者）评估通常将多个评判模型的决定聚合为多数投票，然而这种陪审团式的决策过程并不能保证对单个样本的评估是可靠的。我们提出了结构化交叉拟合不确定性风险（SCUR），这是一种基于评判陪审团行为来估计实例级评估可靠性的无标签方法。潜在测量模型作为测量系统分析的骨干，SCUR从中导出三个互补信号，分别捕获陪审团不确定性、测量交叉熵和扰动敏感性。这三个证据来源被组合成一个风险分数。我们在五个真实世界基准上，通过多数投票错误排序、选择性信任和风险分层来评估SCUR方法。此外，我们展示了我们的方法在检测高共识风险样本方面更加有效，而这些样本正是许多其他LLM-as-a-judge评估方法的盲点。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需标签的实例级评估可靠性估计方法SCUR，通过潜在测量模型导出陪审团不确定性、测量交叉熵和扰动敏感性三个互补信号来构建风险分数，能够比现有方法更有效地检测出高共识风险样本这一评估盲点。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SCUR, a label-free approach that estimates instance-level reliability of LLM-as-a-judge evaluations by combining three complementary signals—panel uncertainty, measurement cross-entropy, and perturbation sensitivity—derived from a latent measurement model, proving more effective at detecting high-consensus risk items that other evaluation methods miss.
